authority.grant_scope_requested: Re-bind the standing persistent MCP dashboard product runtime to Host build 0da3a18b52647a91e4cf2b13349af09dc7c60fec6b3ac13067c1f3f31372decb (named session profiles). Dashboard behaviour, target, pacing, budgets, reconnect/reclaim semantics and the absence of raw-send/target-selection are all unchanged from Runtime 002; only the trusted Host binary changes. Grants no streaming authority: the streaming_ack_clock profile requires its own reviewed manifest and grant.
authority.revocation: runtime/wsl/install_openditoo_product.sh --uninstall stops/disables product service, restores prior collector state, and moves a revoked policy record under .openditoo-local/revoked/

behavior.collector_ownership: product runtime collects while connected and while backing off; standalone collector timer is transactionally disabled and restored on uninstall

build.host_note: Runtime 003 trusts the Host build that adds NAMED SESSION PROFILES. The dashboard's own behaviour is unchanged: an absent profile resolves to 'activity', which keeps the 150 ms Host floor and 10 ms packet spacing exactly as Runtime 002 had them, and the supervisor does not request a profile. The new 'streaming_ack_clock' profile exists in the binary but is reachable only by a separately reviewed streaming manifest, never by this product policy. The Host also now returns hostFrameElapsedMs per frame. Python supervisor code is byte-identical to Runtime 002, so runtime_revision stays 2.

description: Persistent plug-and-play MCP activity dashboard for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus; Runtime 002 adds telemetry-only live session observability. Runtime 003 re-binds the policy to the session-profile Host build.

install.startup_boundary: Windows user logon / StartWhenAvailable; WSL is user-scoped, so this is the reliable Windows startup boundary

session.renewal: fresh unique Host session after lifetime/budget; displayed frame persists across brief socket rollover
